description: For the maximum of three independent exponential lifetimes of rates \(a,a,b\), the hazard is increasing exactly when \(b=a\) or \(b\ge2a\).
limitations: Exactly three independent positive-rate exponential lifetimes with the first two rates equal; no claim for all distinct-rate triples, dependent components, or general baseline survival distributions. Relevant related two-component full text remains uninspected, so independent novelty is unconfirmed.
scientific_integrity: The analytic all-parameter proof is separate from finite exact-arithmetic diagnostics. Bibliographic searches cannot establish uniqueness; no independent mathematical or priority audit has been performed.
title: A sharp doubling threshold for increasing hazard in three exponential lifetimes
